caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven fabric displayed vertically on a plain, off-white background. The fabric consists of alternating patterns in deep blue and off-white, creating a checkerboard-like composition. The patterns vary in design: some sections feature solid blue and off-white squares arranged in a grid, while others contain intricate linear motifs with zigzags, diamonds, and cross shapes. The border areas of the fabric display more elongated and linear designs, while the inner rectangles and squares contain tighter, dense motifs. The lower edge of the fabric fringes slightly. The artist’s signature, "Chrissotfelis," appears in small, blue letters underneath the lower right edge of the fabric against the off-white background.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
